findings.message: This HTML composition file has 304 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: <video class="bg-clip" data-start="0" data-track-index="0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.

findings.message: <video> has data-start but no id attribute. The renderer requires id to discover media elements, so this video will be FROZEN in renders.
findings.fixHint: Add a unique id attribute: <video id="my-video" ...>

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#e5-grid .unit-dot" for backgroundColor between 0.40s and 0.58s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#e5-grid .unit-dot" for scale between 0.40s and 0.58s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: 156 tl.fromTo() calls target "#e5-grid .unit-dot" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0.4s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Font families used without @font-face declaration: microsoft jhenghei, pingfang tc, noto sans tc. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files. For an OS-bundled system font (e.g. Hiragino Sans, Microsoft YaHei) that has no downloadable file, use src: local('Exact Font Name') instead. The declaration alone satisfies this check without needing a font file.
